title: Conjectured coefficients in the transfer-matrix expansion for Camassa–Holm peakons
statement:
Let $\tau_m(z)$ be the transfer matrices, let $\Lambda(z)$ be the spectral function, and let $\mathfrak h^{(k)}$ denote the Hamiltonians defined by the degree-$1$ terms of the transfer matrices. For each $m$, write

$$
\tau_m(z) = \sum_{j=1}^m\Lambda(z)^j\sum_{0< k_j\leq k_{j-1}\leq\cdots\leq k_1,\,k_1+k_2+\cdots+k_j=m} a_j(k_1,k_2,\ldots,k_j)\\,\mathfrak h^{(k_1)}\mathfrak h^{(k_2)}\cdots\mathfrak h^{(k_j)},
$$

with $a_1(m)=1$.

**Conjectured coefficient formula.** The coefficients satisfy

$$
a_m(1,1,\ldots,1)=1,
$$

and

$$
a_{j+1}(m-j,\underbrace{1,\ldots,1}_{j})=\frac{m}{m-j},\qquad 0\leq j<m-1.
$$

The other coefficients $a_j(k_1,k_2,\ldots,k_j)$ remain to be determined.

These formulas are suggested by the explicit transfer matrices through $m=7$; the remaining coefficients are not determined in the source, so the conjecture is open.
references:
**5 papers in this index state this conjecture** (2018–2025). The statement above is taken from the most recent of them; the others are [arXiv:2508.18731](https://arxiv.org/abs/2508.18731), [arXiv:2503.11912](https://arxiv.org/abs/2503.11912), [arXiv:2001.11599](https://arxiv.org/abs/2001.11599), [arXiv:1808.01008](https://arxiv.org/abs/1808.01008).

Source: https://arxiv.org/abs/2512.11066

Status: no resolution is reported in the source (as of December 2025).
source_name: J. Avan, L. Frappat and E. Ragoucy, “Quadratic Poisson brackets for the Camassa–Holm peakons”, arXiv:2512.11066 (2026).
